answer.original_source: NN, Inc.; the announcement date is not specified (reported by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01).
answer.new_information: NN announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant to produce liquid cooling for NVIDIA AI data center racks. The record does not state when the capacity will be operational or quantify any effect on NVIDIA. The article also reports that the added capacity is pre-sold and targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026, but those are separate claims and the target is not a reported result.
answer.reason: There are no catalog questions or stored pieces to update. This is supplier-capacity context, not an investment judgment about NVIDIA that would warrant proposing a new question.
